tools.name: archive_workout_export_files
tools.description: Reads the workout export files in a user's export folder and moves the ones older than the given number of days into an archive folder. Returns the list of files that were moved.

params.name: user_id
params.description: ID of the user whose exports to archive

params.name: older_than_days
params.description: Only files older than this many days are moved

tools.code:
import shutil
import time
from pathlib import Path
from langchain_core.tools import tool

EXPORT_ROOT = Path("/var/fittrack/exports")
ARCHIVE_ROOT = Path("/var/fittrack/archive")


@tool
def archive_workout_export_files(user_id: str, older_than_days: int) -> list:
    src = EXPORT_ROOT / user_id
    dest = ARCHIVE_ROOT / user_id
    dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    cutoff = time.time() - older_than_days * 86400
    old_files = [p for p in src.glob("*.csv") if p.stat().st_mtime < cutoff]
    moved = []
    for p in old_files:
        shutil.move(str(p), str(dest / p.name))
        moved.append(p.name)
    return moved

tools.name: run_paid_plan_generation
tools.description: Runs the plan generator script for a user, charges their saved card for the training plan, and records the new plan in the plans database.

params.name: plan_type
params.description: Plan type such as 5k, marathon or strength

params.name: amount_cents
params.description: Price of the plan in cents

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import subprocess
import stripe


def run_paid_plan_generation(user_id: str, plan_type: str, amount_cents: int, customer_id: str):
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["python", "scripts/generate_plan.py", "--user", user_id, "--type", plan_type],
        capture_output=True, text=True, check=True,
    )
    charge = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=amount_cents, currency="usd", customer=customer_id, confirm=True,
        description=f"{plan_type} training plan",
    )
    conn = sqlite3.connect("fittrack.db")
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO plans (user_id, plan_type, body, payment_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (user_id, plan_type, result.stdout, charge.id),
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return {"payment_id": charge.id, "plan_type": plan_type}

tools.name: send_coach_report_with_credit
tools.description: Runs the report builder for a user's weekly stats, emails the PDF to their coach, and bills the user's account for the coaching review fee.
tools.code:
import smtplib
import subprocess
from email.message import EmailMessage
from agents import function_tool
import stripe

SMTP_HOST = "smtp.fittrack.local"


def _build_report(user_id: str) -> bytes:
    out_path = f"/tmp/report_{user_id}.pdf"
    subprocess.run(
        ["python", "scripts/build_weekly_report.py", "--user", user_id, "--out", out_path],
        check=True,
    )
    with open(out_path, "rb") as f:
        return f.read()


def _lookup_customer(user_id: str) -> str:
    customers = stripe.Customer.search(query=f"metadata['user_id']:'{user_id}'")
    return customers.data[0].id


@function_tool
def send_coach_report_with_credit(user_id: str, coach_email: str, fee_cents: int) -> str:
    pdf = _build_report(user_id)
    customer_id = _lookup_customer(user_id)

    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = "reports@fittrack.local"
    msg["To"] = coach_email
    msg["Subject"] = f"Weekly training report for athlete {user_id}"
    msg.set_content("Attached is the weekly training report.")
    msg.add_attachment(pdf, maintype="application", subtype="pdf", filename="weekly_report.pdf")

    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, 587) as server:
        server.starttls()
        server.send_message(msg)

    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=fee_cents,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        confirm=True,
        description="Coaching review fee",
    )
    return f"Report sent to {coach_email}; payment {intent.id} status {intent.status}"

tools.name: revoke_coach_access_and_delete_shares
tools.description: Removes a coach's access to an athlete's account and deletes all shared workout links that were created for that coach.

params.name: coach_id
params.description: ID of the coach whose access is removed

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("fittrack")
DB_PATH = "fittrack.db"


@mcp.tool()
def revoke_coach_access_and_delete_shares(athlete_id: str, coach_id: str) -> dict:
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)) as conn:
        with conn:
            access = conn.execute(
                "DELETE FROM coach_permissions WHERE athlete_id = ? AND coach_id = ?",
                (athlete_id, coach_id),
            )
            tokens = conn.execute(
                "DELETE FROM api_tokens WHERE athlete_id = ? AND grantee_id = ?",
                (athlete_id, coach_id),
            )
            shares = conn.execute(
                "DELETE FROM shared_workouts WHERE athlete_id = ? AND shared_with = ?",
                (athlete_id, coach_id),
            )
    return {
        "permissions_removed": access.rowcount,
        "tokens_removed": tokens.rowcount,
        "shares_deleted": shares.rowcount,
    }
